rules.title: Relocation assistance for no-fault evictions (RSO/JCO)
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay relocation assistance to tenants evicted for a not-at-fault reason from units covered by the RSO or JCO. The amount depends on whether the tenant is eligible or qualified, the length of tenancy and income, and is paid per unit.
rules.key_value: Eligible: $11,000 (<3 yrs) / $14,400 (3+ yrs or low income); Qualified: $23,150 / $27,400 (July 1, 2026–June 30, 2027)

coverage_conditions.summary: Units covered by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance or Just Cause Ordinance where the tenancy is ended for a not-at-fault reason (owner/relative/manager occupancy, demolition, conversion, government order to vacate, etc.).
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Not-at-fault evictions only; amounts differ for demolition for new construction of Protected Units with lower-income tenants (see RPO).

rules.exemptions: Evicting a resident manager to replace with another resident manager; evictions required by hazardous conditions from a natural disaster not caused by landlord negligence.
rules.interaction: Demolition for new construction of Protected Units with lower-income tenants is governed by the Resident Protections Ordinance and State Housing Crisis Act amounts, which may be higher; the RSO/JCO amounts are the minimum.

rules.title: Declaration of Intent to Evict filing for no-fault evictions
rules.requirement: Before terminating a tenancy for a not-at-fault reason, landlords must file a Declaration of Intent to Evict with LAHD. The termination notice may be served only after filing, and a copy of the notice must be filed with LAHD within 3 days of service.
rules.key_value: Copy of notice filed with LAHD within 3 days of service

coverage_conditions.summary: Units covered by the RSO or JCO where the eviction is for a not-at-fault reason.

rules.title: Reduced relocation for Mom and Pop properties (owner/family occupancy)
rules.requirement: Small ('Mom and Pop') landlords may pay reduced relocation assistance for a good faith eviction for occupancy by the owner or an eligible relative, if all four listed conditions are met.

coverage_conditions.summary: Owner or eligible-relative occupancy evictions in buildings with four or fewer rental units owned by landlords meeting the Section 151.30 conditions.
coverage_conditions.owner_conditions: Landlord has not used the provision in the previous three years; owns no more than four units of residential property and a single-family home on a separate lot in the City; any eligible relative does not own residential property in the City.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Applies only to evictions for occupancy by owner, family, or manager.

rules.title: Relocation for single-family dwellings owned by natural persons (JCO)
rules.requirement: When a JCO-covered single-family dwelling is owned by a natural person (including via a controlled trust or entity) who owns no more than four dwelling units and a single-family home on a separate lot in the City, relocation assistance is one month's rent as a payment or credit.
rules.key_value: One month's rent in effect when the termination notice was served

coverage_conditions.summary: Single-family dwellings subject to the JCO owned by a natural person with a small City portfolio.
coverage_conditions.owner_conditions: Owner is a natural person (including via trust or controlled entity) who owns no more than four dwelling units and a single-family home on a separate lot in the City of Los Angeles.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Single-family dwelling subject to the JCO; LAMC 151.30(E) does not apply.

rules.interaction: Bulletin B notes single-family dwellings that are not lower income may be entitled to one month's rent depending on various factors.
rules.quoted_span: one month’s rent that was in effect when the landlord served the written notice

rules.title: Timing and method of relocation payment
rules.requirement: Relocation payments must be made available within 15 days of service of the written eviction notice, or deposited in an escrow account within that period. Multiple tenants share equally, and where more than one amount applies the higher amount is paid.
rules.key_value: Within 15 days of service of the written notice

coverage_conditions.summary: All no-fault evictions requiring relocation assistance under the RSO/JCO.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Escrow option is at the landlord's sole discretion and cost; escrow payments to the tenant are made within 3 working days of a request.

rules.interaction: Under RPO Option 3, state law governs timing of any supplemental amount above the RSO/JCO amounts.

rules.title: Resident Protections Ordinance relocation for demolition for new construction
rules.requirement: Owners demolishing a Protected Unit for new construction within 5 years of filing with LAHD must comply with RPO relocation rules by choosing one of three options. Lower-income households receive enhanced standardized payments, and the owner must pay the highest applicable amount under state and city law.
rules.key_value: Standardized payment: $115,480 extremely low; $96,750 very low; $87,450 low income (July 1, 2026–June 30, 2027)

coverage_conditions.summary: Protected Units (including all RSO units) demolished for new construction with lower-income (80% AMI or lower) households displaced.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Applies to Protected Units demolished for new construction; households above low income receive RSO/JCO Chart A amounts. Penalties for noncompliance start at $250,000 per displaced unit.

rules.interaction: Codifies and expands the State Housing Crisis Act (Gov. Code 66300 et seq.); owner pays the higher of state or city amounts; HCA enhancements apply even where the RPO does not.
rules.quoted_span: Owners have 3 relocation options to comply with the RPO relocation rules.

rules.title: Relocation offset against accumulated rent
rules.requirement: A landlord may offset a tenant's accumulated unpaid rent against relocation assistance owed, except where relocation is owed because a government agency ordered the tenancy terminated or vacated.

coverage_conditions.summary: No-fault evictions requiring relocation assistance under the RSO/JCO.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Offset not allowed where relocation is owed due to a government order to vacate or an order for an unpermitted dwelling.
